caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sets WHERE mtgoCode IS NULL;

caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE artist IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some cards have no subtype information (NULL).
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE subtypes IS NULL;
